name: aibou
description: Remote control for locally running Kiro agent sessions

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aibou/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aibou/pwa build && pnpm --filter @aibou/bridge build && pnpm --filter @aibou/mock-agent build
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @aibou/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aibou/mock-agent build && pnpm --filter @aibou/pwa build && pnpm --filter @aibou/bridge demo
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
